description: This bar chart, titled “Efficiency Reasoning via Chain of Unconscious Thought,” presents two metrics—Accuracy (%) and Token Count—for four different methods: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The horizontal axis displays the method categories, while the vertical axis on the left measures Accuracy (%) ranging from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, and the vertical axis on the right measures Token Count ranging from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. Each method is represented by a single bar with its corresponding value labeled on top. The CoT method has an accuracy of 91.19% and a token count of 676.85. The CoD method shows an accuracy of 80.89% and a token count of 534.24. The CCoT method has an accuracy of 88.50% and a token count of 445.91. The CoUT method displays an accuracy of 88.40% and a token count of 354.46. The bars are color-coded according to a legend at the bottom: CoT is dark red, CoD is brown, CCoT is light gray-blue, and CoUT is dark green. The bars are arranged in the order of the methods as listed in the legend, from left to right, and are not sorted by value. Each bar is solidly filled with its respective color and has no additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines.
